gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold issue concerns an overclaim that directional motion results characterize the tangent-space distribution or determine when inter-mode probability appears. ISSUE-001 instead diagnoses an invalid dominant-region supremum and reach-rate argument in the formal projection framework; it does not recognize the unsupported characterization claim.

The gold issue is the unsupported interpretation of earliest high-noise measurements as a normal-distance stage because spectral separation collapses without an eigengap check. ISSUE-002 concerns applying local drift estimates along unstopped trajectories and proposes stopping at tube exits; it does not diagnose the high-noise spectral-eigengap failure.

The gold issue concerns the numerical estimator accepting a normal-score stationary point without the ridge curvature condition. ISSUE-001 concerns proving manifold and reach properties from an invalid derivative bound; its repair does not require or identify the missing curvature certification for each estimator output.

The gold issue is failure to differentiate the eigenvector field in the Jacobian of F, so the Hessian-only update is not the Newton step. ISSUE-001 analyzes third-derivative bounds, dominant-region coverage, and reach, and contains no diagnosis or repair of the missing product-rule term.

The gold issue concerns applying an unrestricted inverse of Lambda_perp when selected eigenvalues may vanish, requiring a conditioning safeguard. ISSUE-001 concerns a false reach enhancement and unsupported tube-entry proof; it does not identify ill-conditioning or undefinedness of the spectral inverse.
